description: This file defines the ProgrammerOperatorsPanel class, which encapsulates UI elements and interactions specific to programmer mode in a calculator testing framework. It provides properties for various buttons and controls, as well as methods to set shift modes and reset configurations.

classes.name: ProgrammerOperatorsPanel
classes.description: Represents the UI panel for programmer mode in the calculator test framework, providing access to various operator buttons and configuration methods.

methods.name: SetArithmeticShift
methods.description: Configures the shift mode to arithmetic shift by clicking the relevant buttons.

methods.name: SetLogicalShift
methods.description: Configures the shift mode to logical shift.

methods.name: SetRotateCircularShift
methods.description: Sets the shift mode to rotate circular.

methods.name: SetRotateThroughCarryCircularShift
methods.description: Sets the shift mode to rotate through carry circular.

methods.name: ResetWordSize
methods.description: Resets the word size to default by clicking the appropriate button based on current page source.

methods.name: ResetNumberSystem
methods.description: Resets the number system to decimal.
